messages:
Jon M: FYI starterkit CI flakes on structured tool calls when auth retry occurs. Server reports 'unexpected token at end of JSON'.
Priya K: Repro'd. TS retry middleware is JSON.stringify-ing a body already serialized by json-mode helper (which appends a newline delimiter). Retry ends up sending '"{...\n}"' so strict schema parse fails.
Samir P: Py SDK signs bytes(json + '\n') while TS signs json without newline. Retry also changes bytes, so signature parity breaks.
Leah W: Two fixes: (1) retry should not re-serialize if body is string/Buffer and content-type is application/json; (2) signing should be over the canonical bytes actually sent. Add unit tests to assert parity.
Priya K: I'll open a small PR tonight to change retry.ts: compute payloadToSend = (typeof body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(body)) ? body : JSON.stringify(body); sign(Buffer.from(payloadToSend)); send(payloadToSend); and add tests: 401->200 flow + signature compare to Py helper.
Samir P: I'll add a devex docs note: "If using json-mode helpers, middleware must preserve serialized bytes and avoid re-serialization; this preserves signing and schema parity across SDKs."
ci-bot: PR #5123 opened by priya-k: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry; sign canonical payload"  https://ci.redwood/p/5123
Jon M: Great. Once CI passes let's roll the sample-app tests. :rocket:
